definitions.explanation: An exclamation of joy or triumph when something good happens or a goal is achieved.

examples.japanese: やった！⟦{合格|ごうかく}した→合格する：27949_goukakusuru⟧！
やった、⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{勝|か}った→勝つ：01199_katsu⟧ぞ！
やったー！⟦{念願|ねんがん}→念願：17955_nengan⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{一等賞|いっとうしょう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦もらった→もらう：00520_morau⟧！
examples.english: Hooray! I got the first prize I've been dreaming of!

notes:
Derived from the past tense of ⟦やる→やる：02980_yaru⟧ (to do). Used independently as an exclamation of success or joy.

Often elongated for emphasis: やったー！ The longer the vowel, the more excitement is expressed.

Used by all genders and ages. One of the most common exclamations of happiness in spoken Japanese.

CONTRAST: しまった (oh no!) expresses dismay over a mistake — the opposite emotional reaction.
